scope: Read-only independent comparison of every logged successful DFU CRC response with bytes from the untouched installed Valve firmware archive. No radio operations performed.

handoff.shim_confirmation: Startup log confirms one matching disconnect delayed by 500 ms after successful HVC for attribute 28.
handoff.bootloader_connection_established: 01:01:31.889201 at expected incremented address; hardware address omitted.
handoff.interpretation: The grace interval allowed the bootloader connection. SteamVR logged its disconnect intention before the hook delayed the call. The observed disconnect event was a connection timeout, not a clean remote-initiated disconnect.

error_preservation.assessment: Only the initial insufficient-authentication write response was observed, followed by the normal successful authentication flow. The reviewed shim forwards original API return codes and arguments unchanged; it delays one matching disconnect.

completion.conclusion: All 297956 firmware bytes and all 144 init bytes reached their final offsets with matching CRCs; SteamVR reported wireless update success. Persistent firmware-version readback and normal two-station operation remain separate verification steps.
